paragraphs: Rav Acha bar Pinchas, Eruvin 29b; in Rav Yosef’s name, Mo'ed Katan 15a; in Abaye’s time. Rav Acha bar Chanilai, Rabbi Tanchum’s brother, in Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s time. Rabbi Abbahu said, “This is Rav Acha’s statement.”
